items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Farrar was going to work with Shilkret anyway, and Shulkret (phonetic) was in doing -- what they call transcriptions and he was big wheel and power down at the Victor

ctx.x: So I stayed with the band until the end of that engagement. Then another weekend, down comes Rollini, Adrian, and he said that he wanted to know the same thing, "What are you guys going to do?" And he wants to take all the guys but he won't have Steve Brown. Steve Brown was a big feature in our band, because he plays bass himself, but the bass fiddle is out.
So now he wants Bix and I think he wanted Farrar, it seems Farrar was in that; but Farrar was going to work with Shilkret anyway, and Shulkret (phonetic) was in doing -- what they
call transcriptions and he was big wheel and power down at the Victor and he had four or five radio shows, so he was -- you know, he would be the guy for a guy like Farrar to go with. And he did.
